svg.title: Decision chart for choosing between the CX-3 and a scientific calculator

desc.style: color: rgb(34, 48, 63); fill: rgb(0, 0, 0); fill-opacity: 1; fill-rule: nonzero; stroke: none; stroke-width: 1px; stroke-opacity: 1; stroke-dasharray: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-linejoin: miter; opacity: 1; font-size: 17px; font-family: Georgia, serif; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal; text-anchor: start; dominant-baseline: auto; letter-spacing: normal; visibility: visible; paint-order: normal; marker: none;

svg.desc: A navigation problem is tested with one question: does it need a specific gravity? If yes, the scientific calculator is the route, because no CX-3 function exists. If no, the CX-3 has a function, and the four routes are Ground Speed for distance, speed and time; Fuel for fuel problems; CONV UNIT for unit conversions; and Airspeed for temperature.
